text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки got hurt в тренировке, so I
take her
to the infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Guh! I'm fine... or so I'd like to say, but
I'd be
lying... Argh.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... That was pretty good acting,
right? Did
you fall for it?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
You pretending to be fine right now is the real
act.

text_block_list.text:
I turned my charm on up to eleven, and
you still
saw through it?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
What should I do now, director? I shall
submit to
your vision...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Your stage is the track, not here.

text_block_list.text:
What should I do now, director? I shall
submit to
your vision...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Your stage is the track, not here.

text_block_list.text: Yes... I think I'll do... just that.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: But... I have to patrol my dorm tonight...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure my sweet ponies have
favors they
want to ask of me...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: You need to prioritize yourself right now!

text_block_list.text:
Y-you have a point... I'll focus on my
recovery.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You're right. This isn't where I should be
devoting
my performance.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best to return to my true

stage—the racing track!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Let's brainstorm a training regimen that
won't
affect my injury.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ngh!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Apologies... I can't focus because of the
pain...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the rest of the planning to
you...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I can focus on conditioning the other
parts of my
body that aren't injured
first...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh! But I should do some visualization
exercises
so I'll be prepared for
full-body training once I
recover!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I have to do all I can to make sure I'm
ready!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her pain is so distracting that she's
unable to
concentrate on anything else...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки is able to heal faster than
predicted
thanks to the new regimen we
put together!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I watch over Фудзи Кисэки to make sure
she's able to
get enough rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
